# wrapper

> **Directory:** `android/gradle/wrapper`

## Purpose

This directory contains Gradle wrapper configuration used by the project to control how a specific Gradle distribution is downloaded and stored for builds. It centralizes settings that tell the Gradle wrapper where to fetch the distribution, where to keep cached distributions and zip files, and some basic network/time settings.

## Files

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `gradle-wrapper.properties` | This file is a Gradle wrapper properties file that configures how the Gradle wrapper downloads and stores a specific Gradle distribution for a project. The properties indicate the base directory used for distribution and zip storage (GRADLE_USER_HOME), the relative paths under that base for distribution and zip storage (wrapper/dists), the exact distribution URL to download (gradle-8.14.3-all.zip from services.gradle.org), a network timeout value (10000), and a flag to … |

## Key Components

- **`distributionUrl`** (in `gradle-wrapper.properties`) — Specifies the exact Gradle distribution archive (including version and type) the wrapper will download, which determines the Gradle runtime used for building the project.
- **`distributionBase/zipStoreBase`** (in `gradle-wrapper.properties`) — Controls the base directory used for storing downloaded Gradle distributions and zip files (referencing GRADLE_USER_HOME), affecting where cached artifacts are kept and shared on the system.
- **`wrapper storage paths (wrapper/dists)`** (in `gradle-wrapper.properties`) — Defines the relative path under the base directory where distribution contents and zip files are stored, which influences disk layout and cache isolation for the project's Gradle wrapper.
- **`network/timeouts`** (in `gradle-wrapper.properties`) — Includes network timeout settings (e.g., 10000) that affect how long the wrapper will wait for network operations when downloading the specified Gradle distribution, impacting reliability in flaky networks.

## Architecture Notes

This directory contains a single configuration file for the Gradle wrapper. No within-directory imports or inheritance relationships were detected, so the files do not reference each other internally. The gradle-wrapper.properties file encapsulates all wrapper-related configuration for distribution location, storage paths, and network/time settings; because it is the only file here, it is the sole source of wrapper behavior in this directory.
